import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Node {
        int age;
        List<Edge> adjusted = new ArrayList<>();
        Edge back;
    }
    static class Edge {
        Node from, to;
        int flow;
        Edge opposite;
    }
    static final int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    static final double EPS = 1e-10;
    static final long e5 = 100000, e6 = 1000000, e7 = 10000000, e9 = 1000000000;
    static final int[] dr = {1,0,-1,0};
    static final int[] dc = {0,1,0,-1};

    static int adjust(Edge e, int d) {
        if (e == null) return d;
        d = adjust(e.from.back, Math.min(d, e.flow));
        e.flow -= d;
        e.opposite.flow += d;
        return d;
    }

    static void connect(Node a, Node b, int w) {
        Edge ea = new Edge();
        Edge eb = new Edge();
        ea.from = a; ea.to = b; ea.flow = w; ea.opposite = eb;
        eb.from = b; eb.to = a; eb.flow = 0; eb.opposite = ea;
        a.adjusted.add(ea);
        b.adjusted.add(eb);
    }

    static int maxFlow(List<Node> g, Node source, Node sink) {
        int result = 0;
        while (true) {
            for (Node u : g) u.age = 0;
            Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(source);
            source.age = 1;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && sink.age == 0) {
                Node u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : u.adjusted) {
                    Node v = e.to;
                    if (v.age != 0 || e.flow == 0) continue;
                    v.back = e;
                    v.age = u.age + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
            if (sink.age == 0) break;
            for (Edge e : sink.adjusted) {
                Edge o = e.opposite;
                if (o.from.age != sink.age - 1 || o.flow == 0) continue;
                result += adjust(o, o.flow);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextLong()) {
            long n = sc.nextLong();
            long T = sc.nextLong();
            int totalNodes = (int)((T + 1) * n * n + 2);
            List<Node> g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < totalNodes; i++) g.add(new Node());
            int sourceIdx = (int)(T * n * n + (n-1)*n + (n-1) + 1);
            int sinkIdx = (int)(T * n * n + (n-1)*n + (n-1) + 2);
            Node source = g.get(sourceIdx);
            Node sink = g.get(sinkIdx);
            char[][] lab = new char[(int)n][(int)n];
            List<long[]> z = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                String row = sc.next();
                for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    lab[r][c] = row.charAt(c);
                    if (lab[r][c] == 'Y') continue;
                    if (lab[r][c] == 'Z') {
                        z.add(new long[]{r, c});
                        continue;
                    }
                    connect(source, g.get((int)(0 * n * n + r * n + c)), lab[r][c] - '0');
                    lab[r][c] = '0';
                }
            }
            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                String row = sc.next();
                for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    char ch = row.charAt(c);
                    if (ch == 'Y' || ch == 'Z') continue;
                    connect(g.get((int)(T * n * n + r * n + c)), sink, ch - '0');
                }
            }
            for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
                for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                        int curIdx = (int)(t * n * n + r * n + c);
                        int nextIdx = (int)((t+1) * n * n + r * n + c);
                        connect(g.get(curIdx), g.get(nextIdx), INF);
                        if (lab[r][c] != '0') continue;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int r_ = r + dr[d];
                            int c_ = c + dc[d];
                            if (r_ < 0 || r_ >= n || c_ < 0 || c_ >= n || lab[r_][c_] != '0') continue;
                            int nextIdx2 = (int)((t+1) * n * n + r_ * n + c_);
                            connect(g.get(curIdx), g.get(nextIdx2), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
                List<long[]> z_ = new ArrayList<>();
                for (long[] e : z) {
                    int r = (int)e[0];
                    int c = (int)e[1];
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int r_ = r + dr[d];
                        int c_ = c + dc[d];
                        if (r_ < 0 || r_ >= n || c_ < 0 || c_ >= n || lab[r_][c_] != '0') continue;
                        z_.add(new long[]{r_, c_});
                        lab[r_][c_] = 'Z';
                    }
                }
                z = z_;
            }
            System.out.println(maxFlow(g, source, sink));
        }
    }
}
